text:
Nora Kim: heads-up 1 staging build shows a couple of broken anchors after the PR that switched inline JS examples to fenced mdx snippets. CI linkcheck points to docs/guides/sdk.md.
Diego Alvarez: any sample failure text?
Nora Kim: `WARN linkcheck: fragment not found: /guides/sdk#using-the-sync-client` -> site emitted `#/guides/sdk#using-the-sync-client.js` (the `.js` suffix got appended from the fenced snippet filename).
Priya Nair: aha, we started using triple-backtick MDX with a `filename=` attribute in the snippet renderer. the slug generator is accidentally including the filename when building the fragment for the example heading.
Diego Alvarez: quick patch: change the renderer so it strips `.{ext}` from autogenerated example headings, or prefer explicit MD headings above snippets for anchors.
Nora Kim: i prefer fixing the renderer so authors don't have to add extra headings. can you open a small PR for the snippet plugin?
Diego Alvarez: opening PR #4555. patch updates `mdx-snippets/plugin.js` to call `cleanHeading = heading.replace(/\.[a-z0-9]+$/i, '')` before slugifying. added unit test and one docs fixture.
docs-bot: CI: docs/linkcheck failed for commit b7f9a2  1 broken fragment in docs/guides/sdk.md: line 48
Priya Nair: did the patch land locally? run `yarn docs:linkcheck` and check `yarn docs:build` to confirm anchors now match.
Diego Alvarez: ran locally, linkcheck clean. pushed the commit and added a short note in the PR about the root cause and how the snippet filename influenced the anchor.
Nora Kim: we should also add a tiny lint rule that fails if an example heading renders with an extension suffix. easier to catch during authoring.
Priya Nair: agree. add a docs-lint rule that searches for `#.*\.[a-z0-9]{1,4}$` in generated anchors and fails the CI step. that will catch `#...\.js` or `#...\.py` cases.
Diego Alvarez: added lint PR #4560 with test cases. CI for lint green.
docs-bot: CI: docs/build-staging succeeded for PR #4555  all checks passed :white_check_mark:
Nora Kim: nice. follow-ups: Priya to land lint, Diego to merge snippet fix, i will scan other guides for similar filename-influenced anchors and add redirects if needed.
Priya Nair: i'll run `git grep -n "```" docs/ | xargs -n1 grep -E "filename=|file=|source="` and manually check any MDX snippets that used filenames in older PRs.
Diego Alvarez: merged. thanks.
Nora Kim: one small customer note: if you bookmarked an example anchor that ends with `.js`, it should still work because we added redirect entries for the handful we found. i'll add a short blurb in the changelog.
docs-bot: automation: added redirects for /guides/sdk#using-the-sync-client.js -> /guides/sdk#using-the-sync-client
Priya Nair: closing once post-deploy link logs are clean. ping here if any new anchor 404s appear.
